tasks.subject: Scope native iOS PyCode client
tasks.description: Inspect the repository and orchestration mechanics, establish the shared working document, and define an initial additive MVP that supports Claude Code/Codex/Pi-style sessions through a relay.

tasks.subject: Delegate implementation to Codex
tasks.description: Acquire a dedicated worktree/session and brief a Codex subagent to implement the native Swift app and WebSocket relay without React Native.

tasks.subject: Review and verify implementation
tasks.description: Inspect every changed file, run focused tests/builds, re-brief Codex for corrections, and verify delivered behavior against the agreed MVP.

tasks.subject: Finalize and report deliverables
tasks.description: Ensure the change is committed/pushed or otherwise clearly handed off, record evidence and next actions in the orchestration log, then tear down the worker safely.
